{{Short description|Japanese mathematician}}
{{nihongo|'''Hiroshi Saito'''|齋藤 裕|Saitō Hiroshi|6th April, 1947-2nd July, 2010}} was a Japanese mathematician at the [https://www.sci.kyoto-u.ac.jp/en/divisions/math Division of Mathematics and Mathematical Sciences, Graduate School of Science, Kyoto University] who worked on [[automorphic form]]s.<ref>[https://projecteuclid.org/euclid.nmj/1354716554#ui-tabs-1 ''Nagoya Math. J.'', Volume 208 (2012) Preface].</ref> He introduced the [[base change lifting]] and the [[Saito–Kurokawa lift]].
